resources.string: Run “toomux remote pair” on the machine, then enter the one-time code. Normal use is carried over ByteTraverse.

Once connected: tap and double-tap exactly as you would click Toomux · long-press a session for its real menu · tap “keys →” for the Android keyboard · pinch to resize · long-press “toomux” for the real help overlay. In memory, press “o” or long-press “toomux” for the immersive graph.
